primary_diagnosis_treated: Metabolic syndrome with pre‑diabetes, essential hypertension, and early CKD risk

medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually and after any change in renal function
medications.purpose: Control essential hypertension and provide renal protection
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 & NG203 recommend ACE‑I as first‑line for hypertension and CKD with proteinuria or hypertension

medications.dose: Start 500 mg PO once daily with evening meal; titrate after 1 week to 500 mg BID, then to 1000 mg BID as tolerated (max 2000 mg/day)
medications.duration: Lifelong — review annually and after any change in eGFR
medications.purpose: Improve glycaemic control in pre‑diabetes/early T2DM and aid weight loss
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 recommends metformin as first‑line when eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m²

medications.dose: 10 mg PO once daily (taken in the morning)
medications.duration: Lifelong — review renal function and glycaemic response at 3 months then annually
medications.purpose: Renal and cardiovascular protection; modest glucose‑lowering
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG28 & NG203 recommend SGLT2‑i for T2DM and CKD with eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m²

medications.dose: 5 mg PO once daily; increase to 10 mg after 2 weeks if DBP remains >90 mmHg
medications.duration: Lifelong — review BP in 2 weeks and then annually
medications.nice_justification: NICE NG136 recommends CCB as second‑line after ACE‑I when BP remains above target

medications.dose: 20 mg PO once daily in the evening
medications.duration: Lifelong — lipid panel at 3 months then annually
medications.nice_justification: NICE CG181/NG28 advise statin for anyone with QRISK ≥10% or ≥1 CVD risk factor

interactions_checked.interaction: ACE‑I may reduce renal perfusion; if eGFR falls, metformin can accumulate → rare lactic acidosis
interactions_checked.action: Check eGFR before starting metformin and repeat every 3 months; reduce metformin dose if eGFR 30‑45

interactions_checked.interaction: Both lower blood pressure modestly; additive effect possible
interactions_checked.action: Monitor BP and renal function 2 weeks after initiation

interactions_checked.interaction: Synergistic BP reduction → risk of symptomatic hypotension
interactions_checked.action: Counsel patient to rise slowly; check BP after 1 week and after any dose change

interactions_checked.interaction: Both can cause peripheral oedema; additive effect possible
interactions_checked.action: Inspect ankles for swelling; consider lowering amlodipine if oedema problematic
Monitor fasting glucose/HbA1c; no dose adjustment needed
Routine monitoring of CK & liver enzymes as per statin safety

contraindications.reason: eGFR not yet documented; NICE NG28 contraindicates metformin if eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m²
contraindications.alternative: Confirm eGFR ≥30 before starting; if eGFR <30 use dapagliflozin alone

contraindications.reason: eGFR not yet documented; NICE NG28/NG203 contraindicates SGLT2‑i if eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73 m²
contraindications.alternative: Confirm eGFR ≥30 before initiation; if eGFR 20‑30 consider dose‑adjusted SGLT2‑i or DPP‑4 inhibitor

assumptions_warnings: eGFR and urine ACR are missing – required to confirm safety of metformin and eligibility for SGLT2‑i (NG28, NG203). Assume eGFR ≥30 but order serum creatinine‑based eGFR and spot urine ACR before starting.
Lipid profile (LDL, non‑HDL) not available – needed to document baseline and monitor response to atorvastatin (CG181). Order fasting lipid panel.
QRISK score not calculated – needed to justify statin intensity (CG181). Calculate QRISK at next visit.
Liver function tests not recorded – required before initiating atorvastatin (CG181). Order ALT/AST, ALP, GGT, bilirubin.
Pregnancy status unknown – statins and metformin are contraindicated in pregnancy. Confirm patient is not pregnant and discuss reliable contraception.
Allergy history not documented – verify no sulfonamide or statin allergy before prescribing dapagliflozin or atorvastatin.
Alcohol intake quantified only as ‘unhealthy’; may affect liver enzymes and adherence. Screen with AUDIT‑C and counsel on reduction.
treatment_summary: The plan adds metformin XR and dapagliflozin as first‑line glucose‑lowering agents per NICE NG28, introduces amlodipine to achieve BP <140/90 mmHg per NG136, and starts atorvastatin 20 mg for primary CVD prevention per CG181. Lisinopril is continued as the ACE‑I backbone for hypertension and renal protection. All drugs are chronic with annual review, and safety monitoring (eGFR, electrolytes, liver enzymes, lipid panel, HbA1c, BP) is outlined. Missing investigations (eGFR, ACR, lipids, QRISK, LFTs, pregnancy test) are flagged before initiation.
